dict.string: Echo listens when you tap the microphone to ask a question, and to capture conversations for your private memory. Audio is turned into text on your phone and is never sent to Muse.
Echo notes roughly where you were when it heard something, so you can ask where you were. It stays on your devices and is never sent to Muse.
Echo uses a workout session only to keep listening while your wrist is down. It reads nothing from Health.
Echo needs permission to run that session. It never saves a workout to Health.
